newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens to start UK venture with GEC.
newsitem.headline: Siemens to start UK venture with GEC.

text.p: German electronics and engineering group Siemens AG said on Wednesday it would start a British telecommunications joint venture with General Electric Co Plc.
The 50-50 venture, to be called Siemens GEC Communications Systems Ltd, will pool the two companies' British activities in private communications equipment and networks, Siemens said.

The new company, first mooted in a June 1996 letter of intent, will start operations immediately, Siemens said. It will include GPT Business Systems Division, GPT Communications Systems Ltd and Siemens Business Communication Systems Ltd.
Managing director Richard Goddard, now head of GPT Business Systems Division, said the new company, with 3,000 employees, will be active in international markets as well as Britain.
With projected annual sales of about 265 million pounds sterling, it would be Britain's second-largest provider of private communications systems.
